paper.title_en: Born rule in Schroedinger-Newton scenarios of semiclassical gravity
paper.abstract_en: We investigate dynamical relaxation to the Born rule in a semiclassical gravity model described by the Schrödinger-Newton equations. Using a Gaussian variational solution for the self-gravitating wave packet, combined with Nelson's stochastic representation of quantum dynamics, we track the evolution of particle ensembles whose initial probability distribution differs from $|Ψ|^2$. Relaxation to the Born rule ("quantum equilibrium") occurs when the wave packet remains bounded, or grows sufficiently slowly in time; in contrast, for rapidly expanding solutions of the Schrödinger-Newton equations, deviations from the Born rule can persist indefinitely. Numerical simulations confirm this analytical picture. These results show that semiclassical self-gravity can either enable or inhibit relaxation towards the Born rule, providing a minimal model relevant to proposals of primordial quantum non-equilibrium, as suggested by Underwood and Valentini [Phys. Rev. D 92, 063531 (2015)].

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究半经典引力中薛定谔-牛顿方程下的玻恩规则动力学弛豫，结合高斯变分解与Nelson随机表述进行解析与数值分析，问题具体、理论深度适中，且与半经典引力基础问题及原初量子非平衡提议直接相关，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 半经典引力的薛定谔-牛顿情景中的玻恩规则
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由薛定谔-牛顿方程描述的半经典引力模型中玻恩规则的动力学弛豫。利用自引力波包的高斯变分解，并结合Nelson对量子动力学的随机表述，我们追踪了初始概率分布不同于$|Ψ|^2$的粒子系综的演化。当波包保持有界，或在时间上增长足够缓慢时，弛豫到玻恩规则（“量子平衡”）就会发生；相反，对于薛定谔-牛顿方程中快速膨胀的解，对玻恩规则的偏离可以无限期地持续存在。数值模拟证实了这一解析图像。这些结果表明，半经典自引力既可以促成也可以抑制向玻恩规则的弛豫，提供了一个与Underwood和Valentini [Phys. Rev. D 92, 063531 (2015)]所提出的原初量子非平衡提议相关的最小模型。
